title: EDR & MDR Solutions
tagline: Endpoint detection and response, backed by round the clock managed threat hunting.
blurb: Modern attacks move in minutes, so your defence cannot wait for a human to notice. We deploy and manage best in class endpoint detection and response across your fleet, then wrap it in a managed detection and response service that watches every endpoint 24 hours a day. Suspicious behaviour is contained automatically and investigated by real analysts, so an intrusion never gets the time it needs to become an incident.

points.t: CrowdStrike Falcon and equivalent platforms rolled out across every endpoint, tuned to your environment instead of left on noisy defaults.
A dedicated security operations team watching your telemetry every hour of every day, so alerts reach a trained analyst, not an empty inbox.
Analysts actively searching your environment for the quiet, hands on keyboard activity that automated tooling alone will miss.
Compromised hosts isolated in seconds and a documented response playbook that turns a scramble into a procedure.

idealFor: Boards and insurers demanding managed detection
Anyone who has outgrown basic antivirus
deliverable: A fully deployed EDR platform, a 24/7 managed detection and response service, and a tested incident response plan.

faqs.q: How is this different from antivirus?
faqs.a: Traditional antivirus looks for known bad files. EDR watches behaviour across the whole endpoint and flags the subtle activity of a real attacker, while MDR adds human analysts who investigate and respond on your behalf.
Yes. Zyberworks is a CrowdStrike partner and deploys the Falcon platform, alongside other leading tools where they fit your environment better.

faqs.q: Can we try it before committing?
faqs.a: Yes. A 15 day free Falcon trial gives you next-gen antivirus, device control, and express support so you can see it working in your own environment first.
Falcon comes in per-device bundles from Falcon Go through to fully managed Falcon Complete. See the pricing below, and we will build a tailored quote for your fleet.

title: Web & Content Filtering
tagline: Keep users safe online with DNS filtering, category controls, and classroom management.
blurb: The web is where most threats now begin and where productivity quietly leaks away. We design and manage layered filtering that blocks malicious and inappropriate content before it ever loads, gives you clean category based policy, and reports on what is actually happening across your network. For schools and colleges we deliver classroom management and student safety built on Blocksi, our authorised technology partner for Australia and New Zealand.

points.t: Malicious, phishing, and inappropriate sites blocked at the network layer before a browser ever renders them.
Granular, group based policy so different teams, year levels, or sites get exactly the access they should.
Live screen visibility, tab control, and focus tools for teachers, delivered through our Blocksi partnership.
Wellbeing and safeguarding alerts plus clear reporting for leadership, IT, and compliance obligations.

idealFor: Organisations with duty of care obligations
deliverable: A deployed filtering platform, group based policy, and safeguarding reporting your leadership team can rely on.

faqs.a: ChromeOS, macOS, iOS, Windows, and Android. Each runs a lightweight extension or agent, all managed from one cloud console with no extra hardware to install.
No. The solution is cloud based. Devices only need a quick extension or agent install to come under policy.

faqs.q: Can teachers keep their existing tools?
faqs.a: Yes. Classes import from Google Classroom, Canvas, and others, and secure study kiosks support more than 25 LMS platforms.

faqs.q: What happens when the safety system flags something?
faqs.a: The AI detects concerning content, then a human safety expert reviews it and the school is notified only when it is a genuine threat.

points.t: Methodology aligned to the OWASP standard, covering authentication, session management, business logic abuse, and injection classes.
Simulated attack paths from perimeter access through to full domain compromise, scoped to your environment.
